Larry Ellison Cancels Planned Sale of Oracle Stock

Larry Ellison has canceled his plan to sell up to $7.5 billion worth of Oracle stock. The specific reasons for the cancellation were not disclosed in the coverage. The planned sale was reported by multiple financial news outlets.
